title: Notation adapter: schema — add notation block to game definition
description: Add optional notation object to game-definition.schema.json with: piece_symbols (map component type to display char), capture_marker, promotion_marker, check_marker, checkmate_marker, disambiguation (file_then_rank|rank_then_file|none), special_moves (map notation string to action dict). Also add to Rust Zone/GameDefinition and Python definition.py.
close_reason: Added notation block to JSON schema, Python GameDefinition.notation field, parsing and serialization.
